note: Peru: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for tourism, for 183 days in a year (El Salvador, Mexico, Qatar), 90 days (most, some extendable to 180 in a year) or 60 in a year (the Dominican Republic). Everyone else needs a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy of Migraciones' list.

sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Peru without a visa for tourist purposes for the following period: 183 days El Salvador Mexico Qatar 90 days European Union member states (except Ireland) Andorra Antigua and Barbuda Argentina Australia Bahamas Barbados Belarus Belize Bolivia Brazil Brunei Canada Chile Colombia Cook Islands Costa Rica Dominica Ecuador Fiji Georgia Grenada Guatemala Guyana Honduras Hong Kong Iceland Indonesia Ireland Israel Jamaica Japan Kiribati Liechtenstein Malaysia Marshall Islands Micronesia Moldova Monaco Mongolia Montenegro Nauru New Zealand Niue North Macedonia Norway Palau Panama Papua New Guinea Paraguay Philippines Russia Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa San Marino Serbia Singapore Solomon Islands South Africa South Korea Suriname Switzerland Taiwan Thailand Tonga Trinidad and Tobago Turkey Tuvalu Ukraine United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Uruguay Vanuatu Vatican City 60 days Dominican Republic
